description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointment of Commission to Investigate about the Bomb blasting Incidents on 21st April, 2019
reasoning: This gazette content details the appointment of a Commission of Inquiry by the President to investigate the 2019 Easter Sunday attacks. The appointments are of judicial officers (Judges of the Court of Appeal, a retired High Court Judge) and a retired Ministry Secretary to conduct investigations and inquiries into law enforcement failures and related matters. This falls squarely under the "Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes" category (Type 9), which covers commissions of inquiry, judicial appointments for investigative purposes, and law enforcement procedures.
